v0.2.4.description:
**⚠️ Existing seeds must be regenerated.** Location names and item classifications changed, so a run generated on v0.2.3 or earlier will not work with this build. Finish it on the old version or reroll.

### Fixed

- **The Skill Shop sometimes opened as the normal shop instead of the AP shop** — capsule purchases didn't send checks, and the client froze for several seconds at a time. The shop now loads AP stock reliably and without the stall.
- **Crash when entering your first Dragon Arena fight** after picking a stage.
- **Winning a fight sometimes sent a DeathLink death.** If the KO registered just before the results screen appeared, your win was reported as a death.
- **Quitting a Dragon Arena fight sent its death at the wrong moment** — it stayed queued and fired later, usually when you next walked into the arena. It now fires when you quit.
- **Seeds with ShopSanity off:** the Skill Shop was emptied on every entry, so you couldn't buy anything with your Zeni.
- **Kid Gohan's Frieza fight was mislabeled** as First Form — it's Third Form.

### Changed

- **Fight names are consistent.** Frieza uses ordinals (`Frieza 1st/2nd/3rd/Final Form`); Cell uses his real form names (`Imperfect Cell`, `Semi-Perfect Cell`, `Perfect Cell`) instead of a mix of numbers and parentheticals.
- **Skill capsules are now `useful` instead of filler** — all 11 Breakthroughs plus every DU character ability (transformations, signature attacks, Unlock Potential, fusions). They're weighted better in placement and surface in trackers and hints. They still aren't required by logic.

### New

- **`/deathlink`** toggles DeathLink on or off mid-run from the client, and it sticks across reconnects.
v0.2.4.title: v0.2.4

v0.3.0.description:
### New

- **Map helper (`map_helper`, on by default).** The Dragon Universe map shows everything the current chapter has to offer, so you can find your checks without a guide. Each point has a marker in the world and a coloured dot on the overview map: red for fights, green for talk scenes, and so on. Second-playthrough and level-locked points are shown too, which adds 28 fights as checks.
  - A saga is split into chapters. A **purple** marker opens the next chapter, a **pink** one the previous; a **white** marker goes to the next saga and a **grey** one back to the last. Each needs X and plays the real scene.
  - By default the next-chapter and next-saga markers appear once you win the fight that opens them. `map_free_travel` makes them always available.
  - Turning `map_helper` off also turns Saga locks and Interactsanity off.
  - A story's ending no longer rolls credits the moment you win its last fight. It waits behind a white marker, so you can finish the rest of the map first.
- **Item names on the map (`map_item_labels`).** Hovering over a point shows the Archipelago item waiting there and who it is for, coloured by importance: plum for progression, blue for useful, cyan for filler, salmon for traps.
- **Item names in the Skill Shop (`shop_item_labels`).** The shop list shows what each capsule sends, coloured the same way.
- **Saga locks (`saga_locks`, on by default).** The Frieza, Cell and Buu sagas each need a `Saga Unlock` item before any character can move on to them. The saga a character starts in is always open. The three items can turn up in any order; a saga needs every unlock up to it.
- **Interactsanity (`interactsanity`: off / items / talks / both, default both).** Visiting map points sends checks: 204 pickups and 312 talk scenes. Locations are named by chapter and place, and pickups say what the spot holds in the normal game, for example `Goku DU - Saiyan Saga - Ch.1 - ??? near East City (Dragon Radar)`.
- **Fighter unlocks (`fighter_unlocks`, on by default).** The 27 fighters without a Dragon Universe story (Frieza, Cell, Trunks and the rest) are `Fighter` items, locked in every mode until found.
- **Extra skills (`extra_skills`, on by default).** Up to 187 more skill capsules join the item pool: the other fighters' skills and Breakthroughs, fusion forms, and the remaining Dragon Universe character skills.
- **Experience items.** Filler now alternates between Zenie and Experience (x1000, x2500, x5000). An item goes to the character you are playing when it arrives, or the next one you play. The level-ups come on the next fight you win, with the usual stat choice.
- **`/map on|off`** turns the map helper on or off for the session and shows its state.

### Changed

- **`dragonsanity` is now a choice:** `all` (default) keeps every Dragon Ball and each wish as a check, `wishes` keeps only the wishes, `off` neither. `true` and `false` in an old yaml still work.
- **Dragon Ball checks count pickups.** The game hands out a random missing ball, so `Dragon Ball: Goku #1` is now the first ball Goku picks up, whichever it is.
- **Dragon Arena appears on the main menu as soon as the ticket arrives.** You no longer have to enter and leave Dragon Universe to make it show.
v0.3.0.title: v0.3.0

v0.3.1.description:
**Black Label is now supported** by everything added in v0.3.0. If you put `map_helper: false` in your yaml to play v0.3.0 on Black Label, you can take it out.

Seeds made with v0.3.0 work with this version.

### New

- **Black Label (CRC `2a4b60eb`)** works with the map helper, saga locks, Interactsanity, the item names on the map and in the Skill Shop, and Dragon Arena appearing on the main menu as soon as the ticket arrives. Greatest Hits (CRC `c97ef0a4`) is unchanged.

### Good to know

- Black Label has no Cooler-route Frieza fight for Goku. Its check, `Goku DU - Frieza Final Form (Cooler Route)`, is sent together with `Goku DU - Frieza Final Form`.
v0.3.1.title: v0.3.1

v0.4.0.description:
**⚠️ Existing seeds must be regenerated.** Fight location names changed, so a seed made with v0.3.1 or earlier will not work with this build.

### Changed

- **Fight locations are named by saga and chapter**, like the talk scenes and pickups already were. You can tell where a fight is from its name:
  - `Goku DU - Raditz` is now `Goku DU - Saiyan Saga - Ch.1 - Raditz`
  - `Adult Gohan DU - Piccolo` is now `Adult Gohan DU - Buu Saga - Ch.2 - Piccolo`

### Fixed

- **`Teen Gohan DU - Cell Saga - Ch.2 - ??? Talk 1` could not be reached.** It is a hidden spot in the far north-west corner of the map, so small that flying over it never triggered it. With the map helper on it now responds like any other point.

Both game versions are supported, as in v0.3.1: Greatest Hits (CRC `c97ef0a4`) and Black Label (CRC `2a4b60eb`).
v0.4.0.title: v0.4.0

v0.4.1.description:
Seeds made with v0.4.0 work with this version.

### Fixed

- **Some map points stayed hidden even with the map helper on.** The game can tie a point to a story variable so that it only shows for one value. Piccolo's two Central City talks in the Saiyan saga are set up that way, so only one of them ever appeared. Ten points are affected in all, for Piccolo, Vegeta, Yamcha and Broly; the map helper now shows them all.
v0.4.1.title: v0.4.1
